findings.name: Broad base.group_user full CRUD
findings.observed: security/ir.model.access.csv grants base.group_user read/write/create/unlink on all four enrichment models; group roles alone cannot prevent forged audit/state.
findings.required_proof: Test direct RPC create/write/unlink, manager, employee, portal and cross-company.

findings.name: Bulk Inject circumvents per-field consent
findings.observed: action_inject -> _inject_gate_proposal applies all 8 allowlisted missing partner fields after one action.
findings.required_proof: Test pending/rejected fields cannot write, old Inject cannot bypass.

findings.name: ADR-012 contradicts current feature defaults
findings.observed: Accepted ADR-012 says auto_writeback=1 default; gate_icp_seed and gate_config require two explicit flags, both seeded 0. Existing tests exercise live mode.
findings.required_proof: Test both flags 1 still cannot silently apply during per-field-review campaign; retain historical ADR.

findings.name: Retired cron privilege grant
findings.observed: post_init_hook grants enrichment-manager group to system_cron; both old cron methods no-op/active=False. Actual installed membership and other uses unknown.
findings.required_proof: Census actual user/group jobs; revoke narrowly only after no valid consumer.

findings.name: No run-level company/record rules
findings.observed: Enrichment run and provenance have partner but not native company scope; base.group_user CRUD broad and no addon-specific ir.rule seen.
findings.required_proof: Test allowed-company and shared-partner rules; no partner creation.

findings.name: Legacy local inject remains reachable
findings.observed: action_inject on engine_used!=gate enters historical extracted-material profile create/merge, though crawl/extract/inference retired.
findings.required_proof: Keep old data read-only; block fresh local profile creation from legacy branch.

findings.name: State guard can be bypassed
findings.observed: EnrichmentRun.write blocks edits on injected/failed runs only if state NOT in vals; a caller can include state and other fields together.
findings.required_proof: Direct RPC state+proposal tampering must fail; service-owned transition only.

findings.name: Aggregate confidence hidden or misrepresented
findings.observed: Run confidence_score computed solely from extraction_ids; Gate runs can show 0 despite EIE confidence. Missing confidence falls back to 1.0 on applied provenance.
findings.required_proof: Separate run-level EIE confidence from extraction confidence; never fabricate per-field score.

findings.name: No field-level citation in mapped contract
findings.observed: Gate mapper maps EIE completed state and final_fields; aggregate provenance may include KB fragments, but no guaranteed field-level citation.
findings.required_proof: Mark missing field citation honestly; permit human-supported attestation only under explicit rule.

findings.name: Unknown eligible field discarded or degrades
findings.observed: Completed response with no allowlisted fields returns False and Odoo reports degraded; no successful read-only evidence receipt is left.
findings.required_proof: Distinguish no-writable-field from transport failure and retain bounded evidence.

findings.name: Auto-writeback code path still exists
findings.observed: Gate config dual flag may authorize immediate injection in action_execute without review; UI approval requirement conflicts.
findings.required_proof: Per-field review always enforced in scoped addon regardless of legacy toggle; preflight flags OFF.

findings.name: No native proposal line artifact
findings.observed: Only run.gate_proposal JSON, legacy committed provenance rows and Inject button; no per-field decision model.
findings.required_proof: Use minimal in-addon proposal line, preserve historical provenance meaning.

findings.name: No transaction-safe CAS/admission
findings.observed: _apply_converge_writeback tests partner[field_name] truthy; no typed snapshot freshness check, no per-line state audit, and concurrent edits possible.
findings.required_proof: Lock target row, compare canonical snapshot, check company/ACL/allowlist inside one transaction.

findings.name: Retired cron has noupdate XML
findings.observed: cron.xml noupdate=1 and M5 migration forced inactive earlier; edited XML alone does not guarantee installed cron state.
findings.required_proof: Read-only installed cron scan; versioned remediation may force retired IDs off, with explicit evidence.

findings.name: Existing tests assert legacy one-click and live mode
findings.observed: plasticos_enrichment/tests/test_gate_enrichment_fallback.py and plasticos_security_base/tests/test_action_methods.py assume Inject applies and both opt-in flags allow live.
findings.required_proof: Revise positive/negative test expectations at their current owner, no weak assertions.

findings.name: README stale version + ambiguous wording
findings.observed: README frontmatter is 19.0.2.0.1 while manifest is 19.0.2.5.5; old misleading fallback log text remains.
findings.required_proof: Align docs with installed source and fail-closed behavior without editing historical ADRs blindly.

findings.name: Historical review evidence must survive
findings.observed: Provenance is for committed writes, extracted material runs have historical local meaning, and source/crawl rows may be archived.
findings.required_proof: Immutable past rows; safe non-destructive migration and no fake backfilled approvals.

findings.name: Source-only scope is incomplete
findings.observed: Actual Odoo.sh module state, ir.cron, server actions, ACL, groups, Odoo mail/attachments, tenant grants and live packet versions unobserved.
findings.required_proof: U00 mandatory read-only DB/Enterprise closure before code permission.

findings.name: Existing tests and tech debt include exact consumers
findings.observed: tests/test_enrichment_gate_writeback.py, tests/test_gate_match_contract.py, plasticos_security_base/tests/test_action_methods.py, source doc ADR-012 and debt fingerprints require dispositions.
findings.required_proof: Source review plus negative regression and no unrelated performance baseline reshuffle.
